title: Resonant Brane Splatting for Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2606.29453v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution (ASR) reconstructs images at continuous magnification factors. Recent methods accelerate inference by replacing computationally heavy implicit neural decoders with explicit 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS). However, since standard Gaussians are smooth low-pass primitives, modeling edges and fine textures requires multiple overlapping, well-aligned splats, which creates severe bottlenecks during rasterization. To address this, we introduce Resonant Brane Splatting (RBS), a feed-forward ASR framework. RBS replaces flat Gaussians with Branes: expressive primitives that emit spatially varying colors to natively model local contrast and complex textures within a single footprint. We achieve this by augmenting the standard Gaussian envelope with internal Gaussian-Hermite modes, assigning a distinct color coefficient to each. translated_title: 用于任意尺度超分辨率的共振膜溅射
translated_abstract: 任意尺度超分辨率（ASR）能够以连续的放大倍数重建图像。近来的方法通过用显式的二维高斯泼溅（GS）替代计算开销高昂的隐式神经解码器来加速推理。然而，由于标准高斯是平滑的低通基元，要建模边缘和精细纹理就需要多个重叠且对齐良好的泼溅基元，这在光栅化过程中造成了严重的瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了共振膜溅射，这是一种前馈式的任意尺度超分辨率框架。RBS 用“膜”替代扁平的高斯基元：这是一种表达力更强的基元，能够发射空间变化的颜色，从而在单个足迹内原生地建模局部对比度和复杂纹理。我们通过在标准高斯包络中引入内部高斯-厄米特模态，并为每个模态分配独立的颜色系数来实现这一点。其中零阶模态可恢复标准的 GS，而高阶模态则能够捕捉高频……
tldr: 提出“共振膜溅射”框架，用内部含有高斯-厄米特模态、可发射空间变化颜色的“膜”基元替代标准高斯泼溅，从而在单个基元内原生建模边缘与精细纹理，解决任意尺度超分辨率中的光栅化瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Resonant Brane Splatting (RBS) replaces standard Gaussians with expressive Brane primitives that emit spatially varying colors via internal Gaussian-Hermite modes, natively modeling edges and fine textures within a single footprint to overcome rasterization bottlenecks in arbitrary-scale super-resolution.
